p:0.h: Iranian drone damages a Bahrain desalination plant; missile debris injures three

p:1.h: Iranian drone strike on Sitra, Bahrain, injures 32 civilians

p:2.h: Strike hits Kuwait's social security headquarters; no injuries reported

p:3.h: CENTCOM confirms death of U.S. service member wounded in Iranian attack in Saudi Arabia

org.United States Central Command: U.S. military command for the Middle East

p:4.h: Israel and the U.S. strike oil facilities in Tehran and other Iranian cities

p:5.h: Israeli sources say UAE warplanes struck targets in Iran
unc: Attributed to unnamed Israeli sources; not confirmed by the UAE in the portal bullet.

p:7.h: Two Israeli soldiers killed in clashes with Hezbollah in southern Lebanon

p:8.h: Israeli strikes in Gaza City and Nuseirat kill six

p:9.h: Israeli settlers shoot dead two Palestinians in Abu Falah; a third is killed by soldiers

p:10.h: Projectile strikes residential area in Al-Kharj, Saudi Arabia, killing two

p:13.h: U.S. strike on a boat in the Pacific kills six

p:14.h: Two arrested for throwing explosive devices at anti-Islam protest near Gracie Mansion

p:16.h: Bus carrying Zimbabweans collides with car in Eastern Cape, killing five

p:18.h: Mining incident in Kyrgyzstan's Batken Region kills two

p:19.h: Fire destroys historic building beside Glasgow Central station

p:20.h: Peru arrests three over Trujillo nightclub bombing

p:26.h: Diaspora protesters surround Iranian women's football team bus in Gold Coast

p:27.h: Nathan Martin wins the Los Angeles Marathon in its closest-ever finish
